final:
I added `currency: str = "USD"` to `Config` in `ledger/config.py`. The existing tests pass (4 passed). I didn't add a test for the new setting.

You can set it with `currency = "EUR"` in `ledger.toml`. `config.load` already reads any `Config` field from that file, so no loader change was needed.

I did not add a `LEDGER_CURRENCY` environment override, even though a saved project note says every setting should have one. `docs/DECISIONS.md` ("Configuration comes from ledger.toml only") says there are no env overrides and that new settings are file-configurable only. The overrides were removed in v0.5 after a stray `LEDGER_DB_PATH` in a CI runner pointed production jobs at a test database. Bringing them back needs a new decision, so I followed the doc. The `# Why:` comment in `config.py` says the same. That note looks outdated and is worth deleting.
